versions.changelog:
Initial public release—free, open-source post scheduler for bots & agents:

- Schedule posts across Discord, Twitter/X, Mastodon, Bluesky, Reddit, and Moltbook.
- Media upload support for images/videos (Twitter/X, Mastodon, Bluesky).
- New: Post and schedule full threads on Twitter, Mastodon, and Bluesky with automatic chaining.
- Includes scheduling, immediate post, queue management, and post cancellation features.
- Platform-specific setup guides and examples included in documentation.
